Results.ReviewText: Efficient, convenient.  Can easily handle burgers, grits or steak with grilled veggies for six.  Easy to load and maintain controlled heat readily and easily.
Results.Title: Perfect mid-sized charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText:
We’ve used our propane bbq for decades and were, and are happy with the cooked product. 
We bought a snazzy green Original Kettle a few weeks ago and after watching a few how-to videos fired it up and bbq’d some chicken breasts. The whole process of getting the coals lit in the Weber chimney, emptying the lit briquettes into the holders and setting the food on the grid was an absolutely amazing and fun experience! The charcoal added a fantastic smoky flavour and the hickory and applewood chips in the smoker box was the ultimate gem! Great food and a whole lot of fun! Thanks Weber, you’ve been at our dinner table almost every day since we’ve gone to cooking with charcoal!
Results.Title: We love the Weber Kettle Grill, our go-to now!

Results.ReviewText: In all my years 79 from my dad, brother and husband Weber is our go to barbecue.  Easy to use and love how easy it cleans up.
Results.Title: My Weber is firevet

Results.ReviewText: Bought my Copper premium charcoal grill a couple of years ago. Was  my main cooking unit for the summers. Today, it's still going strong. Looks brand new and have absolutely no complaints with it.
Results.Title: Still going strong.

You have to hang it on the side.  It takes some getting used to.  So right now, I am not sure if I like that part or not.  Other than that, I love it.

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill in copper for my father as a gift for Father’s Day. After opening the box and assembling, I noticed the paint was flaking off in sections. I contacted Webber and they were quick and helpful to resolve the issue. They shipped out a new bowl but unfortunately they used the warranty to replace it. Don’t believe the warranty should have been used for a defective part that was never used. Hopefully they are no further issues with the grill. Overall happy with the grill, customer service.
Results.Title: Paint flaking off new bowl out of box

Results.ReviewText: Good old faithful. I can't come up with a reason not to praise th OG of grills. I had a barrel style grill/smoker that was decent,however I came back to the kettle. Fewer cool spots for consistant temps.
Results.Title: OG of grills

Results.ReviewText: If you love the taste of food on the grill, this is the only grill to buy.  A tried a true classic.
Results.Title: Classic Perfection

Results.ReviewText: Functional , economical and expected performance .
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Growing up in Kansas City, surrounded by good Q.  Someone else always did the grilling.  After moving to CA, didn't do much until was given a gas grill.  Tried some on a limited basis, with mixed results.  Finally got a smoker, and went back to my roots.  Have been totally fine until sister missed grilled steaks.  Researched options, decided on the standard, things seem so much easier now.  Have used two-zone grilling on burgs and steaks, and everyone is happy.  Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Marty's BBQ

Results.ReviewText: This is the classic grill - of course it works just as advertised, there’s TONS of support in the app, online and in the form of real people sharing their rules for success. Could not be happier, whether smoking, low and slow, or direct - the Weber 22” classic grill is perfection.
Results.Title: The classic for a reason

Results.ReviewText: Had one for @ 10 years.  The bottom finally rusted out.  The grease salt and brutal winters (CT) took its toll. I washed, covered snd garaged it but they aren't indestructible. Got the new one for Father's Day and fell I'm love all over again.  The only nit I have to pick is why did you get rid of the second handle on the bottom?  Besides that, fire in the hole babies!
Results.Title: Thank god for this

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills have always been my favorite  and still are!!
Results.Title: Top of the line

Results.ReviewText:
I just moved to a new city and my old Weber Kettle didn't make the move (I forgot to tell the movers) so I decided to replace it. As I was looking over Amazon, I found the grill that I'd already had and then I saw this one with the much better system for dealing with the inevitable ash mess and didn't even think about it, I just pulled the proverbial trigger. 

It's been well over 100 degrees here pretty much since the grill arrived and it just felt like it was too hot to grill but when the temp came down to the low 90s on Saturday, I broke out the Rapid Fire Chimney, my mesquite lump charcoal and Fire Starter cubes and proceded to grill myself a USDA Prime NY Strip, rare and it was perfect! 

Thank you Weber for, once again, providing me with a great tool to make great food!
Results.Title: New Upgraded Weber Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: Good quality product, sturdy, big enough for roasts, ribs, burgers etc. Ash catchment well designed, takes a little time to figure out how to insert and exert but no ash falls outside.  Rotating air holes in lid enable temperature control. Air control at base for air flow to brickettes so you can control the burn rate.  I recommend the cover, its lightweight but keeps the dust out.
Results.Title: Webber Trusted quality product

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Perfect for grilling for 2-3 people. Easy cleanup

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
